# What does one class and one room hour earn, and should you teach, hire or rent a room?

> Free yoga, pilates and barre studio calculator: enter classes, reservations, the drop-in, pack and membership mix, late cancels, teacher pay and rent, and see profit per class and per room hour, break-even attendance and whether to teach yourself, hire teachers or rent a room by the hour. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
